callouts.label: Pearl helmet
callouts.text: Broad ceramic dome over a blue-black glass face; paired cyan phosphors, curved smile and annular ear receivers.

callouts.label: Shell construction
callouts.text: Rounded shoulder cups, tapered calf covers, captive service screws and ribbed dark flexible joints.

callouts.label: Cellar apron
callouts.text: Oil-dark saddle leather over the shell; crossed back straps, brass buckles, turned edges and visible saddle stitching.

callouts.label: Service kit
callouts.text: Sommelier’s corkscrew, spanner, burgundy pen and folded wipe in separate layered pockets.

callouts.label: Hands
callouts.text: Five articulated digits with pearl knuckle plates, charcoal bellows and exposed joint pins.
